example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ডাকাবুকা ছেলে, কোনো ভয়ই জানে না।
ডাকাবুকো মেয়ের মতো সাহসী হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a dakabuka boy, knowing no fear.
She has become as courageous as a dakabuko girl.
history: The idiom draws from the image of dacoits (bandits) in Bengali rural history, symbolizing their bold and fearless nature in folklore and literature.
note: Often used to describe bold individuals, especially in rural or adventurous contexts.
